title: Iron Boulder 046/131 Sv: Prismatic Evolutions Holo Pokemon
categoryName: Toys & Hobbies:Collectible Card Games:CCG Individual Cards
descriptionText: The Iron Boulder 046/131 Sv: Prismatic Evolutions Holo Pokemon card features a Beast type creature with 140 HP. Manufactured by The Pokémon Company in the United States, this rare card is part of the Pokémon TCG game and is illustrated by Gidora. The card is made of card stock and has a Full Art design with a Holo finish, making it a desirable collectible for fans of the game.
